messages:
Noah: Hey team — Leila's birthday is next Wed (hybrid). Quick check: cupcakes, pizza, or small gift + card? Hybrid folks will be in the office. Thoughts? @people-ops
Ivy: Cupcakes all the way :cupcake:
Ravi: pizza pls, saves us cutting cake in the kitchen 😅
Lucia: Cupcakes + card sounds nice. I can bring a box of 12 if that helps
Ethan: vote: cupcakes
Ravi: if cupcakes -> can we make sure there are gluten-free options?
Noah: yes GF makes sense. @people-ops do we have a tiny celebration budget?
people-ops: We have a $60 team celebration budget for this month. Cupcakes ~ $30, pizza ~ $40-50 depending on place. GF cupcakes usually a bit pricier. RSVP by Friday and note dietary needs.
Ivy: also can we do a 5-min shoutout in the sync that day? :tada:
Lucia: I can coordinate delivery time and get GF options, will post vendor choices in the thread
Ethan: cupcakes + GF + card = perfect. thumbs up
Noah: tl;dr cupcakes it is. @Lucia please order, I’ll reimburse. Thanks all! :cake:
